title: Wired for Overconfidence: A Mechanistic Perspective on Inflated Verbalized Confidence in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2604.01457v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models are often not just wrong, but \emph{confidently wrong}: when they produce factually incorrect answers, they tend to verbalize overly high confidence rather than signal uncertainty. Such verbalized overconfidence can mislead users and weaken confidence scores as a reliable uncertainty signal, yet its internal mechanisms remain poorly understood. We present a circuit-level mechanistic analysis of this inflated verbalized confidence in LLMs, organized around three axes: capturing verbalized confidence as a differentiable internal signal, identifying the circuits that causally inflate it, and leveraging these insights for targeted inference-time recalibration. Across two instruction-tuned LLMs on three datasets, we find that a compact set of MLP blocks and attention heads, concentrated in middle-to-late layers, consistently writes the confidence-inflation signal at the final token position. translated_title: 过度自信的内在线路：大语言模型中言语化自信膨胀的机制视角
translated_abstract: 大语言模型往往不仅是错误的，而且是“自信地错误”：当它们给出事实性不正确的答案时，它们倾向于口头表达过高的自信，而不是发出不确定性的信号。这种言语化的过度自信会误导用户，并削弱置信分数作为可靠不确定性信号的作用，然而其内部机制至今仍知之甚少。我们对大语言模型中这种膨胀的言语化自信进行了电路级别的机制分析，围绕三个方向展开：将言语化自信捕获为可微分的内部信号、识别出因果性地使其膨胀的电路，以及利用这些洞察实现有针对性的推理时重新校准。在两个指令微调的大语言模型和三个数据集上，我们发现一组紧凑的MLP模块和注意力头——集中在中间至后期层——在最终token位置一致地写入自信膨胀信号。我们进一步表明，对……
tldr: 该论文通过电路级机制分析发现，大语言模型的言语化过度自信由集中在中间至后期层的一小组MLP模块和注意力头在最终token位置写入，并可据此实现推理时的针对性重新校准。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a circuit-level mechanistic analysis showing that LLMs' inflated verbalized confidence is written by a compact set of MLP blocks and attention heads concentrated in middle-to-late layers at the final token position, enabling targeted inference-time recalibration.
